rules.title: Relocation Payments for No-Fault Evictions (Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Temporary Capital Improvement, Substantial Rehabilitation)
rules.requirement: Landlords who evict tenants for owner/relative move-in, permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation benefits to each tenant, subject to a maximum per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly (60+), disabled tenant, or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 max per unit; +$5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren) (rates for 3/1/26-2/28/27, adjusted annually)
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: Amounts are adjusted and published annually each March 1; the archive lists increasing rates back to 8/10/2006.
rules.conflict_note: Document is a historical rate archive; it does not state when Section 37.9C's relocation-payment requirement first took effect, only the annually adjusted dollar amounts back to 2006.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords who evict tenants by withdrawing units from the rental market under the Ellis Act must pay relocation benefits to each tenant, subject to a maximum per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 max per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly (62+)/disabled tenant (rates for 3/1/26-2/28/27, adjusted annually)
rules.interaction: Ellis Act relocation payments are set at a higher rate than the payments for owner move-in/demolition/capital-improvement evictions; amounts adjusted annually each March 1.
rules.conflict_note: Document names only 'the Ellis Act' and does not cite a specific Admin Code subsection for this relocation-payment schedule, so citation is given at the chapter level.
